adjudication.rationale: In `apps/web/packages/features/bookings/lib/handleNewBooking.ts`, `loadUsers` was changed to wrap logic in a `try/catch` and explicitly maps `Prisma.PrismaClientKnownRequestError` to `throw new HttpError({ statusCode: 400, message: error.message })` while mapping all other errors to a generic 500 (`"Unable to load users"`) without any logging. This both (1) misclassifies DB/server failures as client errors (400) and (2) can leak raw Prisma error messages to clients, and (3) removes diagnostic context for non-Prisma failures, matching the finding.
